text.tspan: Source: UC-32 NF1–5, A1–A3, E1–E2; UC-31 NF5, A3, E2

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. UC-32 refers to UC-34 as Inventory, whereas the Inventory title is UC-31. No API or item enum is inferred from that incorrect cross-reference.
